title: Picked up at Sea The Gold Miners of Minturne Creek

After a daring rescue, Sailor Bill, who has suffered a severe injury rendering him mute and bewildered, begins to forge bonds with the crew, especially with Seth Allport, the ship's first mate. Captain Blowser and Mr. Rawlings, the only passenger, work to nurture and protect the boy, all while the ship carries on toward its final destination.
